title: RuleAudit: Outcome-Free Structural Screening for Deterministic Additive Clinical Scores
description: Alpha-stage research software for descriptive structural screening of deterministic additive clinical scores under user-specified synthetic input distributions. The software does not establish predictive accuracy, causality, clinical validity, transportability, or safety.
